create_PatchPixelSamplerConfig: create a PatchPixelSamplerConfig dataclass with patch_size, force_one_patch_per_image, force_fixed_location, and force_center_crop settings

call_set_num_rays_per_batch: call set_num_rays_per_batch on PatchPixelSampler to align ray count to patch size multiples
